rules.statement: A court can act only once and once only, and a succeeding judge cannot rescind the orders of a preceding judge.
rules.supporting_quote: In the concept of functus officio, the personalities who make orders qua judicial officers do not matter. When the holder of the office has once discharged his duty, the duty has come to an end.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 70 of the Civil Procedure Code
